brief: Crews must inspect and address the oil issue on the Ivybridge Creek transformer before the heat event begins, in accordance with SOP-016. Because this unit has ONAN cooling and the supplied documents do not cover ONAN-specific forced cooling failure or sustained-event reductions beyond ambient de-rating, apply the ambient de-rating from MG-021 if the unit cannot be attended before the event. Additionally, as an ageing unit of 45 years with a known defect, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting exposure as directed in MG-023.
